t0: opencode install/packaging targets + Desktop-vs-CLIv2 deltas — survey only
sources: https://opencode.ai/docs/troubleshooting/ (Desktop sidecar + plugin dirs + cache clear)

install_targets.v1_installer: Bun at startup (v1 docs); npm Arborist per PR #44373

desktop_vs_cli_v2_deltas: Desktop runs a local OpenCode server (opencode-cli sidecar) in the background; same plugin dirs and config keys apply.

Desktop v21 loaded npm plugins from ~/.cache/opencode/node_modules/ instead of ~/.config/opencode/, breaking plugins with data files (issue #12222); fixed to install into config directories (PR #12352).
Desktop sends automatic system notifications when a response is ready or a session errors; CLIv2 has no equivalent surface.
Desktop troubleshooting is disable-plugins then clear-cache and restart; CLIv2 uses `opencode service restart` / watched-config reload.
Windows Desktop paths use %USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode and %USERPROFILE%\.cache\opencode variants.
